name: Marisa du'Paige
summary: In the caves outside the Deadmines, Marisa du'Paige fights beside Moonbrook's outlaws. Rare among their laborers and highwaymen, she uses arcane magic in the tunnels of southwestern Westfall.

sections.title: Arcane Talent in the Tunnels
sections.body: Deep in the caves leading toward the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, cutpurses, renegade miners, and thugs guard the tunnels. Marisa du'Paige is a skilled human mage among them. Many spellcasters train in Stormwind's Mage Quarter or serve the Kirin Tor, but Marisa has joined the outlaws and brigands in Westfall's underground passages.

faq.answer: Marisa du'Paige is a rare human mage in the outer caves leading into the Deadmines. While common thieves and laborers patrol these passages, she wields arcane spells to defend the underground network.
Marisa du'Paige appears infrequently in the public cavern system beneath Moonbrook in Westfall, in the tunnels just outside the Deadmines instance portal threshold.

faq.q: Why is a human mage hiding in the Deadmines caves?
faq.answer: Some arcane practitioners leave Stormwind's high towers. Deserters, renegades, and sympathetic commoners have joined the outlaw cause across Westfall, bringing steel and sorcery to their strongholds beneath Moonbrook.

angles.text: Marisa du'Paige shows that arcane training in the kingdom reaches beyond the Kirin Tor's towers and Stormwind's wizard sanctum. Rogue spellcasters readily sell their talents to criminal networks.
As an Alliance adventurer, stay alert for du'Paige in the tunnels beneath Moonbrook. An unexpected spellcaster among the cutpurses can quickly make a skirmish deadly.
